channel.title: The Guide to SEO
channel.description: A practical, no-fluff guide to search engine optimization — how Google ranks pages and how to earn visibility with helpful content, sound technical foundations, and honest measurement.
channel.generator: build.py — a static, no-JS SEO guide generator

item.title: Google Search Console Workflow
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: "A practical Google Search Console workflow: the reports that matter, reading the Performance report, and how to diagnose a drop in Search traffic."

item.title: Does AI Content Hurt SEO?
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: Does AI content hurt SEO? Google rewards original, helpful content however it's made — and targets thin, mass-produced pages. How to use AI safely.

item.title: Page Experience in 2026
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: Page experience isn't one Google ranking signal in 2026. What counts: Core Web Vitals, HTTPS, mobile-friendliness, and no intrusive interstitials.

item.title: Title Tags & Meta Descriptions
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: Why Google rewrites your title tags and meta descriptions, the length limits that actually matter, and before/after examples that earn more clicks.

item.title: Internal Linking and Topic Clusters
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: Internal linking guide shows effective anchor text use and pillar-and-cluster structures that match Google's actual recommendations.

item.title: How to Pass Core Web Vitals in 2026
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: Core Web Vitals guide covers LCP, INP, and CLS thresholds plus concrete fixes that improve each metric for 2026 compliance.

item.title: How Search Works
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: SEO makes sense once you understand Google's pipeline. Learn how crawling, indexing, ranking, and serving decide whether your page ever appears.

item.title: Keyword Research
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: Great SEO starts with intent. Learn to find the terms your audience uses and map each to the right page and the right type of content.

item.title: On-Page SEO
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: On-page SEO makes each page clearly about one topic for both readers and crawlers. Titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, images, and internal links.

item.title: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: Google rewards helpful, people-first content that demonstrates Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trust. Here's how to actually create it.

item.title: Technical SEO
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: Technical SEO removes obstacles between your content and search engines: indexability, sitemaps, mobile, HTTPS, Core Web Vitals, and structured data.

item.title: Link Building & Reputation
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: Links remain a core signal of trust. Learn how to earn them the durable way — and which shortcuts get sites penalized.

item.title: Measuring SEO
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: SEO is a loop. Learn the core tools and metrics to track results, find opportunities, and keep improving.

item.title: Local SEO
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: Local SEO helps nearby customers find you on Google Search and Maps through a verified Business Profile, consistent NAP, reviews, and local schema.

item.title: E-commerce SEO
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: How e-commerce SEO works — category and product pages, unique product content, product structured data, faceted-nav crawl control, and canonicals.

item.title: International SEO
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: International SEO explained — multilingual vs. multi-regional sites, choosing ccTLDs vs. subfolders, and implementing hreflang annotations correctly.

item.title: SEO Audit Checklist
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: A practical, prioritized technical SEO audit checklist — crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, on-page, structured data, and monitoring, with fixes.

item.title: Common SEO Mistakes
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: The SEO mistakes that quietly cap your rankings — keyword stuffing, thin content, blocked pages, bought links — and the exact, sourced fix for each.

item.title: SEO Glossary
item.dc:creator: Connor Enge
item.description: SEO glossary gives plain definitions for crawling, indexing, canonicals, E-E-A-T, and Core Web Vitals each linked to further guides.
